locked_acceptance.performance: At least 10% end-to-end output-token throughput improvement over a contemporaneous common-optimized dense control, confirmed by at least three matched rounds.
locked_acceptance.accuracy: No LongBench-v2 or GSM8K decline with thinking disabled, max_tokens=2048 and normal EOS.
locked_acceptance.correctness: Numerical and multi-step state/output gates pass before endpoint claims.

numerical_correctness.claim_boundary: Representative incremental-effect evidence, not task accuracy.

longbench_v2.claim_boundary: The available preflight is one Dk64 run at max_tokens=1024 and cannot substitute for the final 2048-token three-round gate.

gsm8k.reason: Not run because the candidate failed the performance admission gate.

paper_exactness.claim_boundary: Energy-kernel results must not be labeled paper-exact Strong RRQR.
